children: In three multiple myeloma cell lines, NUC-7738 plus carfilzomib reduced cell viability to 3% in two models and 26% in the third after 96 hours. Each agent alone left approximately half of cells viable; no prior-period comparison was provided.
Strong preclinical activity may support further development, but cell-line results do not establish clinical benefit.
Activity varied across the three models, making clinical relevance and patient selection uncertain.
The combination showed greater proteasome inhibition in one model; this is mechanistic preclinical evidence, not a patient outcome.
Carfilzomib ranked first among 70 partner drugs
The screen supports prioritizing this combination, though it does not establish clinical efficacy.
Combination activity in 28 of 33 solid-tumor models
The findings may broaden development opportunities, but came from laboratory screening at a single NUC-7738 concentration.

This is early-stage preclinical evidence that broadens the potential development rationale for NUC-7738 beyond melanoma. Clinical data or follow-up studies establishing safety, efficacy, and a development plan for the combination would be needed to make this a larger catalyst.
